review.tagline: Azure infrastructure templates for deploying enterprise agent apps on Microsoft Foundry
review.summary: Agent Landing Zone is an azd and Bicep template that provisions a Zero-Trust Azure environment for agent applications on Microsoft Foundry. `azd up` deploys the infrastructure plus UI, orchestrator and ingestion apps, each from its own Azure repository. `azd provision` deploys the infrastructure alone. It was previously named GPT-RAG.
review.audience: Azure teams deploying network-isolated enterprise agent apps with IaC
strengths: Infrastructure-only mode via `azd provision`, with apps deployed later using `azd deploy`
Component versions pinned in manifest.json for reproducible releases
Custom apps can replace the defaults through app-definition.json
MIT license; docs cover network-isolated deployment
weaknesses: Tied to Azure and Microsoft Foundry; no other cloud is mentioned
Default UI, orchestrator and ingestion code live in three separate repositories
README gives no cost, quota or resource sizing figures
Prerequisites and configuration are only in external docs, not the README
needs: Needs Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Developer CLI
